[[Riga]], [[Latvia]] | capacity = | chairman = Juris Keišs | manager = [[Rustam Zabirov]] | league = [[Latvian First League]] | season = [[2018 Latvian First League|2018]] | position = 6th | current = | website = }} '''RTU FC''' or '''RTU Futbola centrs''' is a [[Latvia]]n football club, affiliated with the [[Riga Technical University]]. They are based in the capital city of [[Riga]] and compete in the second highest division of Latvian football (the [[Latvian First League]]) and the [[Latvian Football Cup]].{{cite web|url=https://int.soccerway.com/teams/latvia/ogres-sc--fk33/4072/|title=Latvia – FK RTU – Results, fixtures, squad, statistics, photos, videos and news – Soccerway|publisher=uk.soccerway.com|accessdate=2015-02-18}} From 2017 to 2018 the team partnered with the remnants of the now defunct [[Skonto FC]], playing as '''RTU FC/Skonto Academy''', after Skonto failed to receive the First League licence from [[Latvian Football Federation|LFF]] in 2016.{{Cite web|url=http://sportacentrs.com/futbols/1_liga/09012019-rtu_skonto_academy_1_liga_nespeles_bebri_|title=RTU/"Skonto Academy" 1. līgā nespēlēs, "Bebri" apvienojas ar "Dinamo"|date=2019-01-09|website=Sportacentrs.com|language=lv|access-date=2019-04-01}} The club did not apply for the [[2019 Latvian First League]] season, possibly due to financial issues."}}
